newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MMS GIVES MORE ROYALTIES FUNCTIONS TO STATES.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MMS GIVES MORE ROYALTIES FUNCTIONS TO STATES.

text.p: U.S. Minerals Management Service Tuesday completed a rule to give more federal oil and gas royalties functions to state governments.

Starting Sept 11, states will have authority to receive and process production and royalty reports, correct report errors, perform automated verification, and issue demands, subpoenas and orders to perform restructured accounting and related tolling agreements and notices to lessees.
The expanded list only applies to federal onshore oil and gas leases, not to solid mineral, geothermal or offshore leases, MMS said.
